tool_schemas.name: init-n8n
tool_schemas.description: Creates and stores a connection record for an n8n instance using the provided base URL, auth method, optional secret reference, and owner, and returns the created instance object (including its new instance_id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs do not match the required n8n_* ULID patterns, or auth_secret_ref is provided for an incompatible auth_type. Raises NOT_FOUND if owner_user_id does not exist, CONFLICT if an instance connection for the same base_url already exists for that owner, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to provision instances for the specified owner.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for the connected n8n instance.

base_url.description: Base URL of the n8n instance (e.g., https://n8n.example.com).

auth_type.description: Authentication method used to connect to the n8n instance.

auth_secret_ref.description: Reference to a stored secret containing credentials/token for the chosen auth_type.

owner_user_id.description: Owner user id for this instance connection (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: list-workflows
tool_schemas.description: List all workflows from n8n. Use after init-n8n to see available workflows. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id to list workflows from (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

project_id.description: Optional project id to scope workflows to a single project.

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve a workflow by ID. Use after list-workflows to get detailed information about a specific workflow. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id the workflow belongs to (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to retrieve (ULID with n8n_wf_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: create-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Create a new workflow in n8n. Use to set up a new workflow with optional nodes and connections. IMPORTANT: 1) Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines. 2) Must provide full workflow structure including nodes and connections arrays, even if empty. The 'active' property should not be included as it is read-only.

instance_id.description: Instance id to create the workflow in (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

project_id.description: Project id to place the workflow in (ULID with n8n_prj_ prefix).

nodes.description: Full workflow nodes array (must be provided even if empty).

connections.description: Full workflow connections object (must be provided even if empty).

created_by_user_id.description: User id creating the workflow (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

updated_by_user_id.description: User id to set as last updater (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: update-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing workflow in n8n. Use after get-workflow to modify a workflow's properties, nodes, or connections. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id the workflow belongs to (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to update (ULID with n8n_wf_ prefix).

project_id.description: Move workflow to a different project (ULID with n8n_prj_ prefix).

updated_by_user_id.description: User id performing the update (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: delete-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Delete a workflow by ID. This action cannot be undone. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id the workflow belongs to (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to delete (ULID with n8n_wf_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: activate-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Activate a workflow by ID. This will enable the workflow to run. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id the workflow belongs to (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to activate (ULID with n8n_wf_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: deactivate-workflow
tool_schemas.description: Deactivate a workflow by ID. This will prevent the workflow from running. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: Instance id the workflow belongs to (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

workflow_id.description: Workflow id to deactivate (ULID with n8n_wf_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: list-projects
tool_schemas.description: List all projects from n8n. NOTE: Requires n8n Enterprise license with project management features enabled. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection to query.

created_by_user_id.description: Filter projects by the creating user.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on project name.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create-project
tool_schemas.description: Create a new project in n8n. NOTE: Requires n8n Enterprise license with project management features enabled. IMPORTANT: Arguments must be provided as compact, single-line JSON without whitespace or newlines.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection where the project will be created.

created_by_user_id.description: ULID of the user creating the project.

tool_schemas.name: delete-project
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified project from the given n8n instance and returns the deleted project record (or a deletion acknowledgement) on success. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/project_id are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the instance or project does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized or the instance does not have Enterprise project management enabled.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection containing the project.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to delete.

tool_schemas.name: update-project
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified project’s name in the given n8n instance and returns the updated project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/project_id are malformed or name is empty, NOT_FOUND if the instance or project does not exist in that instance, CONFLICT if the update violates server constraints (for example a duplicate project name where uniqueness is enforced), and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized or the instance does not have Enterprise project management enabled.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection containing the project.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to update.

tool_schemas.name: list-users
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of users for the given n8n instance, optionally filtered by status/role/search and ordered by the requested sort field; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/sort/order/limit, NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not the instance owner.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection to query.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on email, first name, or last name.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create-users
tool_schemas.description: Creates one or more users in the given n8n instance and returns the created user records (or an operation summary) for the submitted batch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the users array is empty/too large, required fields are missing, emails are not valid, or roles are not supported; CONFLICT if a user with the same email already exists in the instance; NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create users.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection where users will be created.

email.description: Email address for the new user.

first_name.description: First name of the new user.

last_name.description: Last name of the new user.

role.description: Role to assign to the new user.

tool_schemas.name: get-user
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single user from the given n8n instance by user_id or by email and returns the matching user record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither (or both) identifiers are provided or if the identifier format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist or no user matches the provided identifier within that instance, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the user.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection containing the user.

user_id.description: ULID of the user to retrieve.

email.description: Email address of the user to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: delete-user
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified user from the given n8n instance and returns the deleted user record (or a deletion acknowledgement). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/user_id are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the instance or user does not exist in that instance, CONFLICT if the user cannot be deleted due to server rules (for example protected/required accounts), and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to delete users.

instance_id.description: ULID of the n8n instance connection containing the user.

user_id.description: ULID of the user to delete.

tool_schemas.name: list-variables
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of variables for the given n8n instance ordered by the requested sort field; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when additional results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/cursor/sort/order, NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized or the instance does not have Enterprise variable management enabled.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

limit.description: Maximum number of variables to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create-variable
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new variable in the given n8n instance and returns the created variable record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name/value are missing or invalid, CONFLICT if a variable with the same name already exists in the instance, NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized or the instance does not have Enterprise variable management enabled.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

tool_schemas.name: delete-variable
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified variable from the given n8n instance and returns the deleted variable record (or a deletion acknowledgement). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/variable_id are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist or the variable_id does not resolve to a variable in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized or the instance does not have Enterprise variable management enabled.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

variable_id.description: Variable id to delete (stored in ops_and_metadata.id for record_type='variable', ULID typically n8n_op_01H8…).

tool_schemas.name: create-credential
tool_schemas.description: Creates a credential of the given type_name in the specified n8n instance and returns the created credential record; if project_id and/or user_id are provided, the credential is created under that owner context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, type_name is unknown, or data does not conform to the credential schema for that type; NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist or the referenced project_id/user_id does not exist in that instance; CONFLICT if the credential cannot be created due to server constraints (for example a duplicate name where uniqueness is enforced); and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create credentials in the requested scope.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

data.description: Credential data payload matching the schema for the given type_name.

project_id.description: Project id to own this credential (ULID, e.g., n8n_prj_01H8…).

user_id.description: User id to own/create this credential (ULID, e.g., n8n_usr_01H8…).

tool_schemas.name: delete-credential
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the credential identified by credential_id from the given instance and returns a deletion acknowledgment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/credential_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the credential does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you are not the credential owner or lack permission on the instance. Raises CONFLICT if the credential cannot be deleted due to the instance refusing the operation (for example, it is still in use by a workflow).

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

credential_id.description: Credential id to delete (stored in ops_and_metadata.id for record_type='credential', ULID typically n8n_op_01H8…).

tool_schemas.name: get-credential-schema
tool_schemas.description: Returns the field/schema definition for the requested credential type_name in the given instance, suitable for validating inputs when creating credentials. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid or type_name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the credential type is unknown to the instance, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to inspect credential types for that instance. Raises RATE_LIMITED if the instance enforces request quotas for schema lookups.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

type_name.description: Credential type name to fetch schema for (e.g., 'githubApi').

tool_schemas.name: list-executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists execution records for an instance, optionally filtered by workflow_id, status, and started_after/started_before, returning results sorted by the requested sort field and order. Results are paged with limit (max 250) and an opaque cursor; provide cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including bad timestamps, unknown sort/order, or an invalid cursor), FORBIDDEN if you cannot access execution history for the instance (or the specified workflow), and NOT_FOUND if workflow_id is provided but no such workflow exists in the instance.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

workflow_id.description: Filter to a specific workflow id (ULID, e.g., n8n_wf_01H8…).

started_after.description: Only include executions started at or after this time (ISO 8601).

started_before.description: Only include executions started at or before this time (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-execution
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the execution record identified by execution_id from the given instance. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/execution_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the execution does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view executions for the instance (or for the underlying workflow). Raises RATE_LIMITED if the instance applies read quotas.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id (ULID, e.g., n8n_inst_01H8…).

execution_id.description: Execution id to retrieve (stored in ops_and_metadata.id for record_type='execution', ULID typically n8n_op_01H8…).

tool_schemas.name: delete-execution
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the execution record identified by execution_id from the given instance and returns a deletion acknowledgment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/execution_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the execution does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to delete execution history for the instance. Raises CONFLICT if the execution cannot be deleted due to instance state restrictions (for example, deletion of running executions is refused).

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the execution.

tool_schemas.name: create-tag
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tag with the provided name in the given instance and returns the created tag record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/blank or instance_id is invalid, FORBIDDEN if you cannot manage tags in the instance, and CONFLICT if a tag with the same name already exists in the instance. Raises RATE_LIMITED if tag creation is subject to quotas.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) in which to create the tag.

tool_schemas.name: list-tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags in the given instance, optionally filtered by q (case-insensitive substring match on name) and ordered by the requested sort and order. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; provide cursor to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid sort/order/limit or an invalid cursor, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view tags in the instance.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) from which to list tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match against tag name.

tool_schemas.name: get-tag
tool_schemas.description: Returns the tag record identified by tag_id from the given instance. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/tag_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the tag does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to view tags for the instance. Raises RATE_LIMITED if the instance enforces read quotas.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the tag.

tool_schemas.name: update-tag
tool_schemas.description: Updates the name of the tag identified by tag_id in the given instance and returns the updated tag record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/blank or IDs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the tag does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to manage tags. Raises CONFLICT if the new name would collide with an existing tag name in the instance.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the tag.

tool_schemas.name: delete-tag
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the tag identified by tag_id from the given instance and returns a deletion acknowledgment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/tag_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the tag does not exist in that instance, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to manage tags. Raises CONFLICT if the tag cannot be deleted due to instance constraints (for example, the instance refuses deletion while the tag is still assigned).

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the tag.

tool_schemas.name: get-workflow-tags
tool_schemas.description: Returns the tags currently associated with the specified workflow in the given instance, as a non-paginated list of tag records in assignment order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id or workflow_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the instance or workflow does not exist (or the workflow is not owned by the instance), and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the instance/workflow.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the workflow.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ULID (n8n_wf_01H8…) whose tags to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update-workflow-tags
tool_schemas.description: Replaces all existing tag assignments for the specified workflow with the provided tag_ids and returns the updated set of associated tag records (non-paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, tag_ids is not an array of ids, or any id is malformed; NOT_FOUND if the instance/workflow does not exist (or is not owned by the instance) or if any referenced tag id does not exist in the instance; and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to modify the workflow or manage tags.

instance_id.description: Instance ULID (n8n_inst_01H8…) that owns the workflow.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ULID (n8n_wf_01H8…) whose tags to replace.

tag_ids.description: List of tag record ids (ops_and_metadata.id) to associate with the workflow (replaces existing associations).

tool_schemas.name: generate-audit
tool_schemas.description: Generates an audit report for an instance (optionally scoped to a project and time range) and returns the report in the requested format, including only the requested sections when include is provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id/project_id is malformed, from_at/to_at are not valid datetimes or from_at is after to_at, include contains unsupported sections, or format is not one of the allowed values; NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist or if project_id is provided but does not exist within the instance; and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view audits for the instance/project.

instance_id.description: n8n integration server instance ULID (instances.id) to generate the audit for.

project_id.description: Optional project scope for the audit (projects.id).

from_at.description: Start of time range (inclusive) to include in the audit.

to_at.description: End of time range (inclusive) to include in the audit.

include.description: Sections to include in the generated audit report.

format.description: Output format for the audit report.

tool_schemas.name: list-instances
tool_schemas.description: List connected n8n instances visible to the caller. Returns only non-deleted instance records and supports filtering by lifecycle status. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the caller is not authenticated or not entitled to view instances.

base_url.description: Filter by exact base URL (case-insensitive match).

owner_user_id.description: Filter instances by owner user id (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

limit.description: Maximum number of instances to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-instance
tool_schemas.description: Fetch a single n8n instance connection by id. Returns the instance object if found. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

instance_id.description: Instance id to retrieve (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: update-instance
tool_schemas.description: Update mutable fields on an existing n8n instance connection (e.g., display name, auth configuration). Returns the updated instance object. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid combinations (e.g., auth_secret_ref incompatible with auth_type) and refuses with NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist.

instance_id.description: Instance id to update (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for the connected n8n instance.

base_url.description: Base URL of the n8n instance (e.g., https://n8n.example.com). Changing this will re-key the connection and may be refused if it collides with an existing connection.

auth_type.description: Authentication method used to connect to the n8n instance.

auth_secret_ref.description: Reference to a stored secret containing credentials/token for the chosen auth_type.

owner_user_id.description: Owner user id for this instance connection (ULID with n8n_usr_ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: set-instance-status
tool_schemas.description: Drive an instance lifecycle transition by setting the instance connection status. Returns the updated instance object. Refuses with CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed by the lifecycle, and refuses with NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist.

instance_id.description: Instance id to transition (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix).

status.description: Target status for the instance connection.

last_error.description: Optional error message to persist when transitioning to status='error'. Ignored for other statuses.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Return the caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption as seen by the integration server. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the presented credential is missing/invalid.

instance_id.description: Optional instance id context (ULID with n8n_inst_ prefix). When provided, returned scopes/quotas include instance-scoped entitlements.
